method: Agent-led simulated persona inspection; wishes and recurring-use predictions are hypotheses, not participant statements

findings.title: Pantry review queue bypasses the available product-match comparison
findings.expectation: A request to confirm product and nutrition offers the candidates already found for that receipt item.
findings.observed: A live synthetic receipt saved two food items and one nonfood item. The queue correctly excluded nonfood. Review Kroger Vitamin D Whole Milk opened a manual details form without the saved USDA candidates. Closing that form returned to Your groceries; expanding the item exposed Review USDA matches and the retained candidates.
findings.wishHypothesis: Put product matching and manual label correction together at the queue entry, so confirming a package does not require discovering a second review path.
findings.missingFeatureCheck: Product matching is present, including barcode, text search and package-serving calculator. This is a routing/discoverability issue, not a request to build product search.
findings.workaround: Close the manual editor, expand the item in Your groceries, choose Review USDA matches.
findings.recurringUse: Potential weekly cost for receipt/pantry users; not relevant to people who only log meals.
findings.confidence: High for observed routing/source; unvalidated for human preference or severity
findings.suggestedAcceptance: For an uncertain food with saved candidates, the queue entry exposes match comparison and manual correction without backing out into a different list; purchase quantity remains explicitly reviewed.

strengths: All five fresh onboarding/all-surface traversals completed: 177 checkpoints, zero captured page errors and console errors.
Live strength, walking and meal proposals remained reviewable; common food response and card totals agreed. This establishes internal consistency, not nutritional accuracy.
Live synthetic receipt retained its September 25 purchase date separately from September 30 capture date; soap was nonfood and did not enter the food-review queue.

Package calculator produced 16 servings from 1 package ×16 servings without applying the selected product. The package confirmation requirement remained visible; no actual package was available or falsely confirmed.
Reviewed receipt spending matched the fictional printed $12.77, persisted after reload and added zero meals. The spending panel explicitly included nonfood household purchases.

16 focused desktop fixtures passed for voice review/cancellation/denial, scanner product/private-label/invalid-code/upload decoding, receipt preview/offline retention and assistant proposal acknowledgment/revocation. Provider/account/device fixtures are not live service or hardware evidence.
limitations: Common all-surface traversal includes browsing and empty states; substantive workflow evidence is supplied separately by deep journeys.
One synthetic receipt is not representative extraction or nutrient-accuracy validation.
Some first snapshots captured lazy loading. Follow-ups waited for final controls; those loading snapshots are not product failures.
No real email, hosted deployment, physical phone, actual speech, or natural human avoidance was tested.
